y-m-33-02.topic: Insali lapho kuhlukaniswa ngesisho se-quadratic nolwazi oludingekayo
y-m-33-02.goal: Bonisa ngezibonelo eziningana ezingenzeka ukuthi insali lapho kuhlukaniswa ngesisho se-quadratic ayinakunqunywa uma kwaziwa inani elilodwa kuphela, sho ukuthi yini enye okumele yaziwe, bese uthola insali ngempela.
y-m-33-02.material: P(x) ngu-polynomial onama-coefficient angempela futhi izinga lawo alaziwa. Iqiniso elilodwa kuphela elaziwa kuze kube manje: uma P(x) ihlukaniswa ngo-x−1, okusele ngu-3. UJiyun uthe, 'Okusele uma P(x) ihlukaniswa ngo-(x−1)(x−2) ngu-3,' futhi uHajun uthe, 'Asikwazi ukusho ngolwazi lwamanje.' Vumela u-Q(x) abe yisiphumo no-R(x) abe okusele uma P(x) ihlukaniswa ngo-(x−1)(x−2). Khona-ke P(x) = (x−1)(x−2)Q(x) + R(x), futhi izinga le-R(x) lingaphansi kuka-2. (Indlela yokufunda: P(x) ithi 'P ka-x', (x−1)(x−2) ithi 'x kususwe 1 kuphindaphindwe ngo-x kususwe 2')

y-m-33-10.topic: Ukuhlukanisa okuhlanganisiwe nokuhlukanisa ngesisho somugqa esinge-coefficient engesiyo u-1
y-m-33-10.goal: Hlaziya lokho okuhlala kufana nokuthi yini eshintsha uma uhambisa umphumela wokuhlukanisa ngo-x−1/2 uye emphumeleni wokuhlukanisa ngo-2x−1, futhi wenze izisho eziningana ezanelisa isimo sensalela.
y-m-33-10.material: Umfundi owafuna ukuthola umphumela nensalela uma u-P(x) = 2x³ − 3x² + x − 5 ehlukaniswa ngo-2x − 1 wasebenzisa ukuhlukanisa okuhlanganisiwe futhi wakuxazulula kanje. (Indlela yokufunda: u-2x³ ngu-'2 x cubed', u-2x−1 ngu-'2x minus 1', u-1/2 ngu-'one half')

y-m-33-10.s.s1.line.3: Okungukuthi, umphumela uma u-P(x) ehlukaniswa ngo-2x − 1 ngu-2x² − 2x futhi insalela ingu--5.

Kufanele ukhiphe u-2, njengo-P(x) = (x−1/2)(2x²−2x) − 5 = (2x−1)(x²−x) − 5, ukuthola umphumela uma kuhlukaniswa ngo-2x−1. Insalela u--5 iyafana kuzo zombili.
y-m-33-10.s.s2.prompt: Khetha zonke izincazelo ezilungile eziqhathanisa ukuhlukanisa u-P(x) ofanayo ngo-x − 1/2 nangu-2x − 1.
y-m-33-10.s.s2.hint.0: Ku-P = (x−1/2)Q + R, bhala ukuthi yiyiphi inombolo ehambela kuphi uma ubhala kabusha u-(x−1/2) njengo-(2x−1).
y-m-33-10.s.s2.hint.1: Ngemuva kokuhambisa, qhathanisa ukuthi yini engena endaweni yomphumela nensalela.

y-m-33-10.s.s2.r.b: Lokhu kukhetha kucabange ukuthi kungani insalela ingashintshi noma umumo wokuhlukanisayo ushintsha.

y-m-33-10.s.s3.hint.1: Qala umise ezinye ze-a, b, c, d, bese unquma izinhlamvu ezisele ukuze zifanele isimo.
y-m-33-10.s.s3.fail.c2: Uma i-coefficient a ye-x³ ingu-0, akuyona isisho se-cubic.
